Starting balance — Special Account — Edit

This guide explains how to set up starting balances for special accounts in Manager.io. The form for entering starting balances includes the following fields:

Special Account

Select the special account that you have created under the Special Accounts tab.

Starting Balance Type

Choose whether the starting balance represents a Debit or Credit amount. Typically:

  • Select Debit for asset accounts.
  • Select Credit for liability accounts.

Starting Balance Amount

Enter the starting balance amount for the selected special account.
